name: Oklahoma
phones_sentence: Oklahoma has no county veterans offices. Service-officer teams, their counties and their phone numbers come from the Oklahoma Department of Veterans Affairs county map pages. Call before you go.

offices.source_title: Oklahoma Department of Veterans Affairs: county map, Northwest Team (Oklahoma County page)
offices.note: Service officers can help with VA claims, pension, survivor benefits and appeals at no charge. Call to be matched with the officer for your county.
offices.selection: Team, counties served, central office address and phones as printed on the department’s county map pages; officers’ names and direct lines omitted. A county listed under two teams shows both.

list.address: Central Office, 2132 NE 36th Street, Oklahoma City, OK 73111
list.organization: Oklahoma Department of Veterans Affairs, Northeast Team
list.note: The Northeast team serves this county. The team’s page also lists an office in Muskogee (P.O. Box 769, Muskogee, OK 74402, 918-781-7766). Oklahoma has no separate county veterans office: this is the regional team’s central contact, and the team’s page prints no office hours.

programs.name: Oklahoma Long-Term Care Ombudsman and adult abuse reporting
programs.organization: Oklahoma Office of the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman
programs.description: Advocacy for residents of nursing homes, assisted living and similar adult care homes, delivered through the area agencies on aging’s ombudsman supervisors and volunteers.
programs.next_step: Call 800-211-2116 and give the county and facility name, or reach the State Ombudsman at 405-521-6734. To report suspected abuse, neglect or exploitation of a vulnerable adult, call the Abuse and Neglect Hotline at 800-522-3511, 24 hours a day, or report online at OKHotline.org. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency; complaints to the licensing agency go to the Oklahoma State Department of Health.

programs.name: Free legal help for Oklahoma veterans and older adults
programs.organization: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma; OK-SPLASH; Oklahoma Lawyers for America’s Heroes
programs.description: Legal Aid Services of Oklahoma (LASO) gives free civil legal help to low-income Oklahomans and takes applications by phone. OK-SPLASH, run with Oklahoma Human Services, gives free legal advice to Oklahomans age 60 and older. The Oklahoma Bar Association’s Lawyers for America’s Heroes program offers free legal advice and assistance to veterans.
programs.next_step: Call LASO at 888-534-5243 (Monday through Thursday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.), or OK-SPLASH at 855-488-6814 if you are 60 or older. Veterans can also ask about the Lawyers for America’s Heroes program at okbarheroes.org.
constraints: LASO handles civil, non-criminal cases and screens by income and household size.
Most free legal programs screen by income, case type and location; ask which you qualify for.

coverage_scope: Referral edition. Oklahoma has no county veterans offices: the Oklahoma Department of Veterans Affairs assigns state service officers to four regional teams, and every one of the 77 counties shows its team’s central contact, marked as a regional contact. Twelve counties are listed under two teams. All 77 counties also show an Area Agency on Aging (eleven areas, from a 2022 state publication) and the statewide long-term care ombudsman line. Five independent living centers are shown for the counties each lists; most counties are not covered by any center in the national directory.
coverage_note: Service-officer teams, counties and phone numbers come from the Oklahoma Department of Veterans Affairs county map pages. Area Agencies on Aging come from Oklahoma Human Services publication 91-27 (revised August 2022); a draft state plan says nine agencies now oversee the eleven areas, so call the statewide line, 800-211-2116, if an agency does not answer. The long-term care ombudsman line comes from the state ombudsman’s page. Independent living centers come from the ILRU national directory. Reviewed November 15, 2026. Contacts are not telephone-confirmed.
